description: Vocal slapback delay. Programs the Delay FX insert wet-only at unity, then feeds it from Vocal send slot 1. Verify time by ear.
name: vocal-slap
notes: Precondition: FX track Delay with delay insert slot 0; Vocal send slot 1 assigned to it (one-time setup in Cubase).
Multi-track preset: select Delay in Cubase for calls 2-5, then select Vocal for calls 6-8. Confirm with session.status before each group.
Response param field shows resolved titles; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Plugin mismatch names the actual insert plugin; adjust the plugin field and resend.
